_comment: Loud, documented staleness waivers for the provenance gate (evals/provenance.py). Every entry needs a non-empty reason; remove an entry the moment the artifact is regenerated. Current entries: the 2026-08-10 hta.org domain move and the four agencies added on 2026-08-12/13 (Elk Grove e-tran, Santa Cruz METRO, SolTrans, Fresno Area Express), all pending the same next promoted eval run. Also waived: the 2026-08-13 system-prompt v10 -> v11 change (scope rule widened from five named agencies to all nine) and the v11 -> v12 change adding VTA as the tenth, both pending the same next promoted eval run.

acknowledged.reason: Five causes, all pending the same regeneration. (1) 2026-08-10: hta-fares source domain moved (humboldttransit.org now 404s; site relocated to hta.org). The refetch rebound corpus_version 0938fff0539a to 35ec70d6359d; the refresh report confirmed no policy-text change, only the source URL and fetch metadata. (2) 2026-08-12: Elk Grove Transit Services (e-tran) added as the sixth agency (etran-fares, etran-senior-pass). (3) 2026-08-12: Santa Cruz METRO (SCMTD) added as the seventh agency (scmtd-fares-passes, scmtd-accessibility, scmtd-tap2cruz); merging (2) and (3) rebound corpus_version to feb21f02c510. (4) 2026-08-12: SolTrans (Solano County Transit) added as the eighth agency, four documents (soltrans-fare-table, soltrans-clipper-card, soltrans-ways-to-pay, soltrans-paperless-fares), rebinding corpus_version to 5e6a24ef0702 (20 documents, 140 chunks). (5) 2026-08-13: Fresno Area Express (FAX) added as the ninth agency, three documents (fax-fares plus the corpus's first two PDFs, the reduced-fare program instructions in English and Spanish), rebinding corpus_version once more to 95794539d1d0 (23 documents, 152 chunks), which is what HEAD now ships. Unlike (1), causes (2) through (5) are all new policy text: the committed scores were computed against a corpus containing none of the four agencies. They remain valid for the cases they cover and say nothing at all about the new E-tran, SCMTD, SolTrans, or FAX cases, none of which has ever been scored live. (6) 2026-08-14 UTC: VTA added as the tenth agency, three documents (vta-fares, vta-regional-transfers, vta-rtc-card), rebinding corpus_version to 491751588366 (26 documents, 167 chunks) on this branch. Like (2)-(5) this is new policy text: the committed scores say nothing about the vta-* cases, none of which has ever been scored live. Three sibling agency branches are in flight concurrently, so the corpus_version HEAD finally ships will be recomputed at the last merge. Regenerate all three artifacts at the next promoted live eval run and remove these entries.

2026-08-13: prompts/system.txt moved v10 -> v11. The scope sentence named five agencies and instructed the model to decline "an agency, place, or service outside the five agencies above", while the corpus had grown to nine. Every gate was green throughout, because nothing compared the prompt to the manifest. The consequence is quiet: a rider asks about a corpus agency, retrieval finds the passages, and the model declines anyway. v11 names all nine and replaces the count with "the agencies listed above" so the sentence cannot go stale again; tests/test_prompt_agencies.py now fails the build if the manifest and the prompt disagree, or if a count is reintroduced. The committed scores were produced under v10 and therefore under the narrower scope rule. They remain valid for the five agencies v10 covered and say nothing about how the model behaves toward E-tran, SCMTD, SolTrans or FAX, which v10 told it to refuse. 2026-08-13/14: v11 -> v12 adds VTA as the tenth named agency, required because tests/test_prompt_agencies.py fails the build when the corpus and the prompt disagree; v12 is marked NOT YET LIVE-VALIDATED in its header. The committed scores were produced under v10 and say nothing about how the model behaves toward VTA. Regenerate at the next promoted live eval run and remove these entries.
